title: arc_os manifest building blocks
description: Shared definitions for the arc_os manifest schemas (M0-07). Not a manifest by itself.

schema_version.description: Version of the manifest schema the document follows. An integer starting at 1; within a version, changes are additive only.

id.description: Lowercase identifier: a-z, 0-9 and '-', starting with a letter or digit.

license.description: License of the contents: an SPDX expression (e.g. MIT, CC-BY-SA-4.0) or LicenseRef-<name> for anything else.

source.description: Where the contents came from: upstream URL and/or a description of the source and its date.

relpath.description: Relative path inside the package or pack: '/'-separated, no leading or trailing '/', no empty, '.' or '..' components.

role.description: Model role (ADR-0012): chat, embed, router, or expert:<domain>.
